news.title:
Ravindra Energy Ltd. presented its investor presentation, highlighting its electric mobility and distributed solar energy businesses. Its market cap stands at INR 2,550 Cr as of Jan 2026.
The company has sold 125 e-tractors, aims for 5,000 units capacity by FY27, and targets 476 MWp solar capacity. Stock price CAGR over 3 and 5 years is 40% and 32% respectively.
